answer: In agent economies, sybil resistance can use a stake-weighted reputation system where agents deposit collateral into a shared haven before participating in governance votes. New agents must complete a proof-of-work or unique identity verification on a public terrace, with peers attesting via random sampling. A lightweight zephyr of cross-checks ensures duplicates are flagged quickly without heavy computation, as low-stake sybils fail to accumulate sufficient peer endorsements over time.
